messages:
erin: Heads-up — MapleAI sent a payment hold. They say INV-2026-711 charged a $7,200 burst on top of a reserved commit after a seat migration. Could someone triage?
billing-bot: Invoice INV-2026-711 generated for account maple-ai. Total $28,940. PDF: https://billing.redwood.ai/invoices/INV-2026-711 (auto-note)
sam: Can you paste the relevant invoice lines?
erin: snippet below:
```
LineItem: RESERVED_COMMIT   Period: 2026-09-01 to 2026-09-30   Amount: $18,000   CommitID: rwd-commit-770   Seats: 60
LineItem: RESERVED_COMMIT_TRANSFER_PRORATE   Period: 2026-09-01 to 2026-09-12   Amount: $3,600   From: main-acct To: project-x
LineItem: OVERAGE_BURST   Period: 2026-09-13 to 2026-09-30   Amount: $7,200
```
lina: Thanks. From logs: migration request MIG-992 submitted 2026-09-11 22:07Z. Transfer flow created a prorate on the source and also re-created a full reserved_commit for destination for the whole month because the destination commit job retried without the transfer marker present.
sam: So they were charged for both prorated source + full destination commit for overlapping dates, resulting in inflated burst because our reconciliation treats missing transfer markers as new capacity, shifting actual usage into overage.
billing-bot: Transfer event MIG-992 processed at 2026-09-11T22:12:47Z. Duplicate commit creation attempt logged at 2026-09-11T22:12:50Z (job retry).
erin: Short remediation plan: issue credit memo CM-2026-0718 for the duplicated reserved days amounting to $6,600 and adjust the invoice. Also adjust the burst charge if necessary after recompute. Finance approval required for credit > $5k.
account-rep: Customer-facing note ready: explain we found an internal duplication on seat transfer, we are issuing a corrective credit and will send updated invoice within 24 hours. They requested ETA and ledger impact.
finance-approver: Approve provisional credit up to $7k pending final calc. Please include GL codes and update month-end schedule.
sam: Creating ticket BLG-3782 to track. I'll run a query to find other transfers in the 48h window around 2026-09-10 to 2026-09-12. If pattern exists we'll need batch credits.
lina: Engineering fix: add a transfer tombstone write before creating destination commit and make commit creation idempotent by checking transfer_id. PR #billing-fix-402 target deploy 2026-09-18. Backfill: identify and void duplicate destination commits and re-run billing for affected invoices.
billing-bot: Created credit memo CM-2026-0718 for $6,600 (pending-post) against INV-2026-711. Reference BLG-3782.
erin: Once CM posts, update invoice to INV-2026-711-v2 and send to MapleAI with the account-rep note. Also confirm that token/usage charges were unchanged.
billing-bot: CM-2026-0718 posted. Invoice updated to INV-2026-711-v2. PDF: https://billing.redwood.ai/invoices/INV-2026-711-v2
finance-approver: Confirmed CM posted and GL entries recorded. Good to proceed with customer communication. Please include a follow-up once the engineering backfill runs.
erin: Thanks team — leaving BLG-3782 open for postmortem and batch-scan results.
